reasoning: Recent Florida Senate polling from the last 45 days shows Republican Ashley Moody ahead by roughly 7 to 10 points, with the best current average at R+7.0 and the latest state-specific poll at R+10.0. I did not find a Florida presidential general-election poll from the last 45 days in the provided results, so the current race read is based on the Senate contest; Florida's statewide Cook PVI is R+3.

sources.name: Pollsmax Florida Senate Polling Average
sources.details: Polling average for the 2026 Florida Senate race shows Ashley Moody at 47.6% and the Democrat at 40.6%, for an R+7.0 margin.
sources.date_range: Last updated August 7, 2026; polling average built from 12 polls

sources.details: University of North Florida poll in the Florida Senate race found Ashley Moody leading Alex Vindman 50% to 40%, a 10-point Republican margin.
